conventions.fovDeg: vertical field of view of the whole reference photo; render at width/height = aspect
conventions.position: camera centre; for eye-level cameras y = groundYFormat0 + eyeHeight (re-snap to the compiled ground and move target by the same dy when the ground changes)
conventions.referencePhoto: the photo the pose was fitted to (poseFrom); referencePhotos holds one photo per time, same place, framing may differ
conventions.poseConfidence: high: footprint overlay within about 1 degree; medium: within about 3 degrees / 3 m; low: framing only

arrivalSquare.note: Pier square (Rıhtım / İskele Meydanı): the strip starts here; cameras c01-c04 stand in it. Polygon in x,z: quay edge (OSM coastline 755588171), Haldun Taner west front, Rıhtım Cd north kerb, 1926 pier apron.

cameras.label: Pier square: the 1926 historic pier (İBB İskele Kütüphanesi), south-east oblique
recognise: white rendered 2-storey pier with hipped red-tile roof, chimneys, small dome
arched loggia on the east side, pointed-arch windows with blue tile panels
square paving meets the pier apron without a step; bollards, benches

cameras.label: Pier square looking west-north-west: square paving, benches, simit cart, historic pier and a City Lines ferry
recognise: wide paved square (large grey setts/slabs, puddle hollows)
historic pier left of centre, ferry with yellow funnel to the right
lamp mast, simit cart, benches, bins, people crossing

cameras.label: Quay edge of the square looking north across the water at the long side of the new pier
recognise: 82 m pier: 2-storey pavilion with hipped metal roof and glazed upper floor, long 1-storey arcade with arched windows
fender tyres along the quay wall, water in the lower half

cameras.label: Pier square looking east at the Haldun Taner (1927 market hall) south-west front and the arcaded sea side
recognise: 2-storey block with Seljuk crest and blue tile bands above arched windows
deep canopy over the arcaded ground floor, lamp mast at left
large open square with people at 10-40 m

cameras.label: İskele Cami T3 stop on Rıhtım Cd looking west: tram track, signalised crossing, kerbs and tactile paving (45 m south-west of the strip crossing)
recognise: "İskele Cami" oval tram-stop sign on a grey pole
embedded T3 rail in asphalt, zebra and yellow tactile strip
bench on concrete feet, blue bin, bollards, ATM row, metro glass pavilion
cameras.offSpineNote: No freely licensed day photo exists at the strip crossing (P6-P7). This is the nearest Rıhtım Cd / T3 view, 61 m south-west of the crossing (tile 2_60); it judges the shared street kit (kerbs, embedded rail, zebra, tactile strips, signal poles, bench, bin). Everything behind the kit is outside the strip.

cameras.label: Yasa Cd west half from an upper window of the north-side row (about 7 m up, photo GPS position) looking west-north-west to the Rıhtım
recognise: 6 m pedestrian lane receding west with the Rıhtım at the end
striped retractable awnings, café tables, projecting signs
mixed façades: 1960s çıkma block, grey-clad refurb, white glass-balcony infill

cameras.label: Yasa × Mühürdar junction plaza and the Aya Efimia precinct from an upper floor (about 19 m up)
recognise: Aya Efimia gate and bell tower, red-tile roofs of the precinct
junction plaza with planters, bollards, lamp post, umbrellas

cameras.label: Junction plaza, Aya Efimia gate in the yellow precinct wall, bell tower behind
recognise: yellow precinct wall with gabled gate, arched fanlight, cross
grey (2024) double door, octagonal-domed bell tower, plane tree
grey concrete pavers with dark accent pavers

cameras.label: Yasa Cd north side: precinct wall with the wooden gate, bench and the Sürmeli Ali Paşa Çeşmesi (1693/94)
recognise: long yellow wall with a two-tone paint band at about 1 m
wooden double gate under a moulded hood, wooden bench
küfeki-stone fountain with pointed-arch niche and marble basin at the right

cameras.label: Strip end at the fish market junction looking south-west down Güneşlibahçe Sk between fish, produce and deli stalls
recognise: awnings on both sides nearly meeting over the lane
fish on tilted crushed-ice tables, produce crates, hanging dried peppers and aubergines
dense crowd, pendant lamp on a span wire

cameras.label: Yasa Cd entrance at the Tavus Sk corner looking east-south-east into the lane (night only: no free day photo here)
recognise: Bambi Cafe row on the left: masonry front, awnings, café chairs
shuttered 1930 lottery kiosk with rolled kepenk on the right
large grey pavers with a manhole, the lane vanishing ESE under warm lamps
